name: Aibotics Inc.
summary: Aibotics Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the study of psychedelics for the treatment of mental health issues in the United States. It provides psychedelic methodologies for the treatment of palliative care, depression, and anxiety. The company was formerly known as Mycotopia Therapies, Inc. and changed its name to Aibotics Inc. in February 2025 Aibotics Inc. is based in Miami, Florida.
